integrity: The cubic defect and all-k formula are derived algebraically. Finite checks are supplemental. Four-point nonmedial existence is credited to prior literature and is not claimed new. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to cubic central extensions over F3 with nonzero decomposable alternating 3-form B wedge L, not all commutative quandles. Potential equivalent generator-statistics formulations in older loop theory remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Rank-detected generating sets in cubic central extensions of ternary midpoint quandles
